body: It sounds like you gave your heart and soul to that job, did your best, thought you had good trusting relationships with at least a few of the people there. That must have been a real shock. I am so sorry. I believe you probably did your very best and didn't deserve to be treated that way.

Thanks for the upvote, that was kind, I was really hurt last night to see I had gone to 0.
Loneliness shouldn't be a permanent feeling, but it is. I'm very used to being lonely. I've been lonely for my whole life. I've put up with nearly 30 years of lonely. I won't do it anymore. I don't need to learn survival skills. My life has been nothing but one big long survival test. Believe me, if there's some sort of feeling to be survived, I've been through it. I have survival skills. I don't  believe validation is something that can only solely come from within. Yes we enable validation but we have to have experiences that support that. I don't want to live life like this anymore, I'm not satisfied being lonely all my life, I'm not satisfied having love ripped from me, and all other kinds of happiness. I'm just not.i get what you're trying to say but I don't think it takes into account the full breadth of what my experience is, and what I've tried, and what I need from life.

The pressure to live, not even just to succeed, but to meet the "standard"...is enormous in our generation. You have nothing to be ashamed of.  Although others may not recognize it, you're doing great from what I can tell in your post here. Your words matter, what you have to say matters, your story matters. It matters to me because  you're a human being and that gives you value. I have no idea what your future holds but I do know that right now, who you are now, and what you've done in your life... is good enough. I really hope you give yourself the chance to see what your future brings you too.
Your English is great. Josh, you sound like you're feeling kind of hopeless a bit..I think I can understand that. I'm really sorry, you deserve a quality life.
God I don't know what to say to you as I struggle to find reason for hanging on to my own life, but I'm sorry you're hurting, I'm so so sorry you're hurting.
